title: The sh -c argument uses double quotes ("echo STDERR_LITERAL_ABC 1>&2") while ev…
body: The sh -c argument uses double quotes ("echo STDERR_LITERAL_ABC 1>&2") while every sibling case in the same file uses single quotes. Biome does not lint test/, so the inconsistency is not caught mechanically. Cosmetic only.

title: The non-Buffer fallback branch (`: ''`) is the only uncovered path in the new m…
body: The non-Buffer fallback branch (`: ''`) is the only uncovered path in the new module. It is genuinely hard to trigger with stdout:'pipe'/stderr:'pipe' (it exists because Bun types SyncSubprocess stdout/stderr as Buffer | undefined), so leaving it uncovered is defensible; noting it only so the gap is a known one rather than an assumed-covered one.

body: The explicit `: PlanPreflightSpawnFn` annotation is now redundant since makePreflightSpawnFn already returns that type. Harmless, and it does keep the type import meaningful at the call site, so this is purely optional.
